instrument.name: WIHIC｜教师支持（实际·英文8题）｜初中｜学生填答

scores.label: Teacher Support (descriptive item mean)
scores.description: Eight equally weighted responses 1–5; higher means more frequent perceived experiences. Project complete-response mean, not a norm or validated standalone score.

interpretations.headline: Teacher Support: reflecting on this class
interpretations.interpretation: This describes how often you notice your teacher taking an interest in you and helping you learn. A higher mean means these experiences were reported more often; it is not a judgement of the teacher’s ability or intentions. The displayed value is the mean of eight complete responses on a 1–5 frequency scale. There are no high/low categories or comparison norms.

guidance.text: Which kind of help would make a current learning task clearer for you?
If it feels safe, ask for one specific kind of help or share the need through a trusted adult.

limitations: Your answers describe your perspective in this particular class. They cannot establish a teacher’s quality, classmates’ intentions or the causes of an experience.

These original English items are separated from the 56-item WIHIC. Standalone eight-item administration and this digital feedback have not been validated. This is not a validated Chinese questionnaire.
A score is shown only when all eight answers are present. Missing answers are not scored as zero or filled in. No local norms, thresholds or rankings are supplied.

An uncomfortable or unfair experience is not your fault. This questionnaire does not ask you to challenge a teacher or fix the classroom on your own; a trusted adult can help you decide what feels safe.

caveats: Your answers describe your perspective in this particular class. They cannot establish a teacher’s quality, classmates’ intentions or the causes of an experience.

These original English items are separated from the 56-item WIHIC. Standalone eight-item administration and this digital feedback have not been validated. This is not a validated Chinese questionnaire.
A score is shown only when all eight answers are present. Missing answers are not scored as zero or filled in. No local norms, thresholds or rankings are supplied.

An uncomfortable or unfair experience is not your fault. This questionnaire does not ask you to challenge a teacher or fix the classroom on your own; a trusted adult can help you decide what feels safe.
result.disclaimer: For research and supportive reflection on classroom experiences. Do not use for teacher appraisal, school ranking, diagnosis or student selection. Discuss concerns with a trusted adult regardless of the score. There is no combined WIHIC total.
